title: NHK for School — 日本の動物たち (Animals of Japan)
description: An NHK for School nature segment introducing common Japanese wildlife: deer (奈良), foxes (北海道), Japanese macaques at Jigokudani, tanuki, and red-crowned cranes in Kushiro. Simple narration and nature photography make vocabulary acquisition accessible at N5 level.
creator: NHK for School
license: © NHK — Educational content free for non-commercial use
